scope: Prefill is the 512-token prompt rate reported by ds4-bench. Steady excludes the first decode step; inclusive includes it. Two repeats are an observed range, not a confidence interval. Output identity is regression evidence, not broad model-quality validation. Both sides ran at a 3,600-expert cache because the 4,600 champion cache tripped the swap-growth guard on a machine with 20 days of uptime and 4.3 GB of swap in use; decode rates on both sides are therefore below the published champion, and every comparison is paired within its group. The one-drive diagnostics generated 60 tokens with the CPU stage trace on and are not qualification arms.
